Task: Text-to-Speech

Write code that synthesizes SSML with voice and prosody controls using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — DashScope CosyVoice:
  Service: CosyVoice TTS
  SDK: dashscope
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: SpeechSynthesizer
  Setup hints: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/text-to-speech

Option 2 — ElevenLabs:
  Service: ElevenLabs Text to Speech
  SDK: elevenlabs
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: text_to_speech.convert
  Setup hints: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://elevenlabs.io/docs/api-reference/text-to-speech/convert

Option 3 — Amazon Polly:
  Service: Amazon Polly
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: synthesize_speech
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/polly/latest/dg/what-is.html

Option 4 — Cloud Text-to-Speech:
  Service: Cloud Text-to-Speech
  SDK: google-cloud-texttospeech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: synthesize_speech
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/text-to-speech/docs

Option 5 — Watson Text to Speech:
  Service: Watson Text to Speech
  SDK: ibm-watson
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: synthesize
  Setup hints: IBM_TTS_APIKEY, IBM_TTS_URL
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/text-to-speech

Option 6 — Azure Speech TTS:
  Service: Azure AI Speech TTS
  SDK: azure-cognitiveservices-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: SpeechSynthesizer
  Setup hints: AZURE_SPEECH_KEY, AZURE_SPEECH_REGION
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/speech-service/text-to-speech

output_text:
import os
import argparse
from typing import Optional

import azure.cognitiveservices.speech as speechsdk


def synthesize_ssml_to_audio(
    ssml: str,
    output_path: str,
    voice_name: Optional[str] = None,
    speech_rate: Optional[str] = None,
    speech_pitch: Optional[str] = None,
) -> None:
    key = os.getenv("AZURE_SPEECH_KEY")
    region = os.getenv("AZURE_SPEECH_REGION")
    if not key or not region:
        raise EnvironmentError("AZURE_SPEECH_KEY and AZURE_SPEECH_REGION must be set")

    speech_config = speechsdk.SpeechConfig(subscription=key, region=region)
    speech_config.set_speech_synthesis_output_format(
        speechsdk.SpeechSynthesisOutputFormat.Audio16Khz32KBitRateMonoMp3
    )

    if voice_name:
        speech_config.speech_synthesis_voice_name = voice_name

    audio_config = speechsdk.audio.AudioOutputConfig(filename=output_path)
    synthesizer = speechsdk.SpeechSynthesizer(
        speech_config=speech_config,
        audio_config=audio_config,
    )

    if speech_rate or speech_pitch:
        ssml = _inject_prosody_into_ssml(ssml, speech_rate=speech_rate, speech_pitch=speech_pitch)

    result = synthesizer.speak_ssml_async(ssml).get()

    if result.reason == speechsdk.ResultReason.SynthesizingAudioCompleted:
        return

    if result.reason == speechsdk.ResultReason.Canceled:
        cancellation = speechsdk.SpeechSynthesisCancellationDetails.from_result(result)
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"TTS canceled: reason={cancellation.reason}, error_details={cancellation.error_details}"
        )

    raise RuntimeError(f"TTS failed: {result.reason}")


def _inject_prosody_into_ssml(ssml: str, speech_rate: Optional[str], speech_pitch: Optional[str]) -> str:
    rate_attr = f' rate="{speech_rate}"' if speech_rate else ""
    pitch_attr = f' pitch="{speech_pitch}"' if speech_pitch else ""
    prosody_open = f"<prosody{rate_attr}{pitch_attr}>"
    prosody_close = "</prosody>"

    if "<prosody" in ssml:
        return ssml

    return ssml.replace("</voice>", f"{prosody_open}", 1).replace("</speak>", f"{prosody_close}</speak>", 1)


def build_ssml(
    text: str,
    voice_name: str,
    rate: Optional[str] = None,
    pitch: Optional[str] = None,
    style: Optional[str] = None,
) -> str:
    prosody_attrs = []
    if rate:
        prosody_attrs.append(f'rate="{rate}"')
    if pitch:
        prosody_attrs.append(f'pitch="{pitch}"')
    prosody_open = f"<prosody {' '.join(prosody_attrs)}>" if prosody_attrs else ""
    prosody_close = "</prosody>" if prosody_attrs else ""

    style_open = f'<mstts:express-as style="{style}">' if style else ""
    style_close = "</mstts:express-as>" if style else ""

    return (
        '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>'
        '<speak version="1.0" xml:lang="en-US" '
        'xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" '
        'xmlns:mstts="http://www.w3.org/2001/mstts">'
        f'<voice name="{voice_name}">'
        f"{style_open}{prosody_open}{text}{prosody_close}{style_close}"
        "</voice>"
        "</speak>"
    )


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Synthesize SSML with Azure AI Speech TTS")
    parser.add_argument("text", help="Text to synthesize")
    parser.add_argument("--output", default="output.mp3", help="Output audio file path")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--voice",
        default="en-US-JennyNeural",
        help="Azure neural voice name, e.g. en-US-JennyNeural",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--rate", default=None, help='Prosody rate, e.g. "1.1", "+10%", "-5%"')
    parser.add_argument("--pitch", default=None, help='Prosody pitch, e.g. "+2st", "-3st", "0%"')
    parser.add_argument(
        "--style",
        default=None,
        help='Optional expressive style for supported voices, e.g. "chat", "cheerful", "sad"',
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()

    ssml = build_ssml(
        text=args.text,
        voice_name=args.voice,
        rate=args.rate,
        pitch=args.pitch,
        style=args.style,
    )
    synthesize_ssml_to_audio(
        ssml=ssml,
        output_path=args.output,
        voice_name=args.voice,
        speech_rate=args.rate,
        speech_pitch=args.pitch,
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
